verdict.rationale: Expensify's Integration Server docs describe a programmatic API. Developers can generate partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret credentials or use an OAuth2 authorization code flow for short-lived access tokens, and can programmatically download expense report data. The evidence never describes scoped tokens, explicit receipt or card-transaction retrieval, or the API being REST. missing for 10: scoped/permissioned tokens, documented receipt and transaction endpoints, explicit REST resource design, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull transactions, expenses, and receipts through a documented REST API with OAuth and scoped tokens

citations.quote: To act on behalf of individual Expensify users, use the OAuth2 authorization code flow to obtain a short-lived access token.
how to programmatically download expense report data for analysis or insertion into your accounting package
